source_title: Tractian's $130M Series D Values the Company at $1.4B to Scale Physical AI for Asset-Heavy Industries - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Round led by Sapphire Ventures values Tractian at $1.4 billion, accelerates efforts to scale multimodal intelligence for asset-heavy industries worldwide
ATLANTA , Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tractian, the leading Physical AI platform for asset-heavy industries, today announced a $130M Series D round led by Sapphire Ventures and co-led with M&G's Catalyst. The round values the company at $1.4 billion and accelerates its evolution from predicting failures to protecting the full health of every critical machine an operation runs on. New and existing investors such as N47, General Catalyst, Bosch Ventures, 53 Stations, Monashees, Endeavor Catalyst, Norte Ventures, and Y Combinator also participated.
Tractian's asset health solution protects the infrastructure that keeps the world running by applying Physical AI to critical machines. Its multimodal intelligence platform leverages vibration, ultrasound and other sensor modalities to sample machine data across a vast array of variables at once, turning those signals into a single living picture of each machine's condition. Tractian's agentic platform, trained on one of the largest industrial failure datasets in existence, then turns that picture into a diagnosis, identifying root causes of any potential problems and providing a recommended plan of action for the operator.
Igor Marinelli, CEO and Founder of Tractian, said, "I grew up watching my father work as a maintenance technician at a paper mill, and I saw how backwards the tools were for the people keeping those machines alive. That sparked my passion to transform how mission-critical assets are maintained in every industry that relies on heavy machinery. This funding round will allow us to scale our platform even further, providing manufacturers, data center operators, defense companies, utilities and more with strategic insights to help optimize the health of their machines, close the alert-to-action gap and eliminate unplanned downtime and lost revenue."
Tractian is trusted by some of the world's largest enterprises to protect the critical assets and infrastructure powering their operations. From pharmaceutical giants like Eli Lilly to McKesson's high-tech distribution centers, Whirlpool's appliance manufacturing operations, Coca-Cola bottling facilities, Cummins' industrial engine production, and Embraer's cutting-edge manufacturing plants, as well as undisclosed customers operating mission-critical data centers and government infrastructure, Tractian is helping keep essential industries running. Today, more than 2,000 critical facilities worldwide rely on Tractian's technology to keep their equipment running, with no surprises or unexpected outages.
"The AI boom is driving a massive build-out of physical infrastructure, and the companies building and running it can't afford equipment failures. Tractian is meeting the moment, winning big industrial customers and building a Physical AI platform that gets sharper with every machine it monitors," said Anders Ranum, Partner at Sapphire Ventures. "When we led Tractian's Series C, we believed that combining hardware, data, and AI would give the company a real edge. Since then, our thesis has only strengthened. We're thrilled to once again lead Tractian's latest round and continue our partnership with Igor and his team."
Unplanned downtime costs the world's 500 largest industrial companies roughly 11% of annual revenue, or about $1.4 trillion a year (Siemens, True Cost of Downtime, Jan 2026). Aging infrastructure compounds the problem, with industrial fixed assets now averaging 24 years in service.
At the same time, the people who know those machines best are leaving at an accelerated rate. Deloitte projects that over 2.1 million manufacturing jobs could go unfilled by 2030. The hard-earned veteran knowledge of how each machine functions or fails will depart with them.
For many asset-heavy companies and those that depend on them, any increase in unplanned downtime can be devastating, from pharmaceutical lines where a brief stoppage or temperature change can mean the loss of an entire production run to data center operators whose software customers may cancel contracts if KPIs are missed.
Tractian was built to solve these challenges. The company's solution puts individual knowledge regarding a machine's performance where the next technician can reach it, transforming the expertise of an operator's retiring workforce into something a plant, and its people, keep.
Tractian's solutions are trusted where downtime isn't an option, keeping compressors, chillers, palletizers, pumps, backup systems and more running across pharma, food and beverage, oil & gas, datacenters, government and defense, energy and water, and the manufacturing plants pulling production back onto American soil.
About Tractian Tractian is the Physical AI that keeps the world's infrastructure running, ensuring your everyday life stays uninterrupted by outages you never knew could happen. By combining physically deployed sensors with its proprietary AI trained on one of the largest industrial assets datasets in existence, Tractian gives reliability and operations teams the ability to protect assets at every layer, and act on evidence instead of instinct.
